name: workspace-alpine
description: esbuild bundle of Alpine.js and its plugins for the workspace Django project. Replaces the jsdelivr CDN tags in base.html - two of which used a floating 3.x.x range that made any pinning impossible - with a local IIFE bundle committed to statics and served via whitenoise. Alpine holds decrypted vault entries in its reactive state on the passwords pages, so a tampered third-party build would leak them. Rebuild with `npm run build:alpine` after bumping the pinned versions.
